title: PACK-15 assertion-stream event payload (v1)
description: Produced by epd2_eligibility_service.voting_trust_events.build_assertion_event. Shared by eligibility_assertion.minted, eligibility_assertion.released, eligibility_assertion.revoked, eligibility_assertion.expired, eligibility_assertion.redeemed, eligibility_assertion.replay_rejected and the four assertion_pickup.* types (created, redeemed, expired, replay_rejected); eligibility_assertion.queued uses pack15-assertion-queue-payload.v1.schema.json instead. It deliberately omits the assertion's nonce, its purpose and its required_assurance_satisfied flag, and carries no credential reference of any kind - an assertion reference and a credential reference never share a payload (ADR-093).
